card.name: Digits inside ISBN numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit (5, 6 or 8) early in an ISBN or DOI number, in book citations and reference lists. It marks the publisher part of the number.

modes.label: Digit after ISBN prefix
modes.description: A digit right after 'ISBN 1-' or 'ISBN 978-1-' in a book citation.

modes.label: Digit in unhyphenated ISBN
modes.description: A digit early in an ISBN written without hyphens.

modes.label: Digit in DOI of a book
modes.description: A digit in the book-style DOI that begins 10.1007/978-3-.

card.plain: It fires on the digits in a book's ISBN number inside a reference citation.
